questions.question: At Willowmoore Park Main Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
It took South Africa Women 23 attempts before they finally beat Australia for the first time in any format. When did that first win come?
questions.explanation: South Africa beat Australia for the first time in a T20I at Manuka Oval, Canberra, on 28 January 2024, having lost 22 of the previous 23 meetings and tied one, in 2016.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Eastern Storm or Limpopo Lillies?
At which ground did Mary-Anne Musonda record their career-best bowling figures (3-18, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Knights on 2013/11/09.

questions.question: Annelie Minny set a database record (13/14 season, T20) with a value of 57. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Fastest 100 (by balls)', held by Annelie Minny.

questions.question: At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — highest total of 369, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.
